intent_en: Show that Ikea's Stichting Ingka foundation ranks among the world's largest charities and is only about 30% smaller than the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation.
narration_support: All this legal fine print makes Ikea the third largest charity in the world, only 30 % smaller than the Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation.
